name: @archstudio/web-lite
description: Dependency-free reference client (DOM + Canvas 2D). Runs today with only esbuild; the Next.js/Three.js app in apps/web reuses the same app-core.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=dist/app.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for (const f of ['index.html','styles.css']) fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/'+f)"
